knowledge:
- key_parameters: col_preproc_method=Method for column-level preprocessing (e.g., "colprofile") ;; block_preproc_method=Method for block-level preprocessing (e.g., "largest_sv" or "unit_var") ;; num_PCs=Number of global factors/principal components to compute ;; tol=Convergence tolerance for the iterative NIPALS solver ;; plots=Plotting behavior during decomposition ("none" or "all") ;; deflationMethod=Deflation method used ("global") ;; projection=Type of projection for plotting ("global") ;; orders=Vector of factor indices to plot (e.g., c(1, 2)) ;; color_col=Metadata column name or index used for coloring plots ;; color_pal=Color palette vector or function ;; test_data=MAE object containing test data for out-of-sample prediction
- alternatives: mogsa and omicade4 are alternative MCIA implementations. nipalsMCIA is preferred for larger datasets due to its iterative NIPALS solver (which offers speed-up over SVD-based approaches) and its integrated preprocessing and deflation options. DropletUtils or standard Seurat pipelines can be used for initial single-cell preprocessing before running MCIA.
- when_to_use: Use when you have multi-block (multi-view) datasets (e.g., matching samples with mRNA, miRNA, and protein levels, or single-cell GEX and ADT data) and want to perform joint dimensionality reduction to find shared and block-specific trends.
- pitfalls: Ensure sample names match across data blocks (use simple_mae to format correctly). Using default block preprocessing ("unit_var") might lead to imbalanced block contributions compared to "largest_sv". Feature names cannot have underscores (_) in Seurat (replaced with dashes -), which might affect downstream string splitting if not handled carefully. Ensure the colData slot of the MAE object is loaded with sample-level metadata prior to invoking visualization functions like projection_plot().

workflows.name: multiblock_mcia_decomposition
workflows.intent: Perform MCIA on multi-block data (e.g., mRNA, miRNA, protein), visualize global scores, block weights, and feature loadings.
input: data_blocks (list of data frames representing different omics blocks with matching samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert data list to a MultiAssayExperiment (MAE) using simple_mae() ;; 2. Run MCIA decomposition using nipals_multiblock() ;; 3. Visualize global scores using projection_plot() ;; 4. Visualize sample clustering using global_scores_heatmap() ;; 5. Visualize block contributions using block_weights_heatmap() ;; 6. Visualize feature loadings using vis_load_plot(), vis_load_ord(), and ord_loadings()
workflows.code:
data_blocks_mae <- simple_mae(data_blocks, row_format = "sample")
set.seed(42)
mcia_results <- nipals_multiblock(data_blocks_mae, col_preproc_method = "colprofile", num_PCs = 10, tol = 1e-12, plots = "none")
slotNames(mcia_results)
projection_plot(mcia_results, projection = "global", orders = c(1, 2))
data_blocks_mae <- simple_mae(data_blocks, row_format = "sample", colData = metadata_NCI60)
set.seed(42)
mcia_results <- nipals_multiblock(data_blocks_mae, col_preproc_method = "colprofile", plots = "none", num_PCs = 10, tol = 1e-12)
meta_colors <- get_metadata_colors(mcia_results, color_col = 1, color_pal_params = list(option = "E"))
projection_plot(mcia_results, projection = "global", orders = c(1, 2), color_col = "cancerType", color_pal = meta_colors, legend_loc = "bottomleft")
global_scores_heatmap(mcia_results = mcia_results, color_col = "cancerType", color_pal = meta_colors)
block_weights_heatmap(mcia_results)
colors_omics <- get_colors(mcia_results)
vis_load_plot(mcia_results, axes = c(1, 4), color_pal = colors_omics)
all_pos_1_vis <- vis_load_ord(mcia_results, omic = "all", factor = 1, absolute = FALSE, descending = TRUE)
mrna_pos_1_vis <- vis_load_ord(mcia_results, omic = "mrna", factor = 1, absolute = FALSE, descending = TRUE)
ggpubr::ggarrange(all_pos_1_vis, mrna_pos_1_vis)
all_pos_1 <- ord_loadings(mcia_results, omic = "all", factor = 1, absolute = FALSE, descending = TRUE)
mrna_pos_1 <- ord_loadings(mcia_results, omic = "mrna", factor = 1, absolute = FALSE, descending = TRUE)

workflows.name: out_of_sample_prediction
workflows.intent: Predict MCIA global scores for new test samples using a model trained on a training set.
workflows.stages: 1. Convert training and test sets to MAE objects using simple_mae() ;; 2. Train MCIA model on training MAE using nipals_multiblock() ;; 3. Predict global scores for test MAE using predict_gs() ;; 4. Extract global scores and metadata for visualization
workflows.code:
data_blocks_train_mae <- simple_mae(data_blocks_train, row_format = "sample", colData = metadata_train)
data_blocks_test_mae <- simple_mae(data_blocks_test, row_format = "sample", colData = metadata_test)
MCIA_train <- nipals_multiblock(data_blocks = data_blocks_train_mae, col_preproc_method = "colprofile", num_PCs = 10, plots = "none", tol = 1e-9)
meta_colors <- get_metadata_colors(mcia_results = MCIA_train, color_col = 1, color_pal_params = list(option = "E"))
global_scores <- nmb_get_gs(MCIA_train)
MCIA_out <- data.frame(global_scores[, 1:2])
MCIA_out$cancerType <- nmb_get_metadata(MCIA_train)$cancerType
colnames(MCIA_out) <- c("Factor.1", "Factor.2", "cancerType")
MCIA_test_scores <- predict_gs(mcia_results = MCIA_train, test_data = data_blocks_test_mae)

workflows.name: single_cell_cite_seq_mcia
workflows.intent: Run MCIA on single-cell multi-omics (GEX and ADT) data to analyze joint embeddings and cell-type specific trends.
input: obj (processed and annotated Seurat object containing RNA and ADT assays)
metadata_sc (data frame containing cell-type annotations and metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract normalized matrices for GEX and ADT from Seurat object ;; 2. Combine matrices into a list and convert to a MultiAssayExperiment (MAE) ;; 3. Run MCIA using nipals_multiblock() with block-level preprocessing set to "largest_sv" ;; 4. Visualize eigenvalues, global scores, heatmaps, and loadings
workflows.code:
data_rna <- GetAssayData(object = obj, layer = "data", assay = "RNA")[VariableFeatures(object = obj), ]
data_rna <- as.matrix(data_rna)
data_rna <- t(data_rna)
data_adt <- GetAssayData(object = obj, layer = "data", assay = "ADT")
data_adt <- as.matrix(data_adt)
data_adt <- t(data_adt)
data_blocks_sc <- list(mrna = data_rna, adt = data_adt)
data_blocks_sc_mae <- MultiAssayExperiment::MultiAssayExperiment(lapply(data_blocks_sc, function(x) SingleCellExperiment::SingleCellExperiment(t(as.matrix(x)))), colData = metadata_sc)
mcia_results_sc <- nipals_multiblock(data_blocks = data_blocks_sc_mae, col_preproc_method = "colprofile", block_preproc_method = "largest_sv", num_PCs = 10, tol = 1e-9, deflationMethod = "global", plots = "none")
meta_colors_sc <- get_metadata_colors(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc, color_col = "CellType", color_pal = scales::viridis_pal, color_pal_params = list(option = "D"))
colors_omics_sc <- get_colors(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc)
global_scores_eigenvalues_plot(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc)
projection_plot(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc, projection = "global", orders = c(1, 2), color_col = "CellType", color_pal = meta_colors_sc, legend_loc = "bottomright")
global_scores_heatmap(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc, color_col = "CellType", color_pal = meta_colors_sc)
block_weights_heatmap(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc)
vis_load_plot(mcia_results = mcia_results_sc, axes = c(1, 4), color_pal = colors_omics_sc)
